blocks.text: בְּקוֹל סַעֲרַת שׁוֹפָר: לְיוֹדְעָיו יוּשַׁב. לְאוֹת טוֹב יִתְחַשֵּׁב. לְעֵת יִתְיַשֵּׁב. בְּקוֹל טַעַם שׁוֹפָר: מוֹאֲסָיו לְהַבְקִיעַ. בּוֹגְדָיו לְקַעֲקֵעַ. מוֹרְדָיו לְהַשְׁקִיעַ. בְּקוֹל חִזּוּק שׁוֹפָר: מַאֲרִיךְ בְּהִתָּקֵעַ. מְקַצֵּר בְּהִבָּקֵעַ. מֵרִיעַ וְתוֹקֵעַ. בְּקוֹל שִׁלּוּשׁ שׁוֹפָר: נוֹתֵן אֵימוֹת. מַחְפִּיז אֻמּוֹת. נוּסוּ נוֹאֲמוֹת. מִקּוֹל בּוֹךְ שׁוֹפָר: נוֹתֵץ חוֹמוֹת. מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת. נוֹהֵם כַּהֲמוֹת. קוֹל שַׁאַג שׁוֹפָר: סוֹדוֹ כְּגִלָּה. בְּסִין לְסֶגֻלָּה. סִים מְגִלָּה. בְּקוֹל הִלּוּךְ שׁוֹפָר: סוֹד יוֹם גְּאֻלָּה. בְּחָסְפּוֹ לִדְגוּלָה. שָׂשׂוֹן וְגִילָה. קוֹל יַשְׁמִיעַ שׁוֹפָר: עָשׂוֹר דּוֹחֶה. עֹנֶג מַדְחֶה. עֲבֵרוֹת מְמַחֶה.

blocks.text: through the stormy sound of the Shofar. For those who know Him, there is comfort, it is reckoned a good sign for the establishment of peace through the pleasant sound of the Shofar. They who reject Him will be cut down, the faithless will be uprooted, rebels will sink down through the powerful sound of the Shofar. It sounds long drawn-out blasts and then short sharp notes, Teruah and Tekiah are included in the threefold sound of the Shofar. It spreads fear, shakes nations so that they speak of flight from the menacing sound of the Shofar. It tears down walls and makes an end of wars, like the roaring of the waves is the roaring sound of the Shofar. When the Lord revealed His will to His own people on Mount Sinai, the Revelation concluded with the long drawn out sound of the Shofar. When once the secret of redemption will be revealed to those exalted, jubilation and rejoicing He will proclaim through the sound of the Shofar. verdict: PARTIAL / NOT APPROVED. I read all 13 supplied images; none was removed or unreadable, and no media limit was hit. The English on s301 matches the draft exactly, including punctuation and curly quotes. I made two Hebrew patches: לְקַעֲקֵעַ, and עוֹרְרַנִי (to be confirmed by a human). Three role labels (ח׳, unpointed) are recorded with their placement. The Hebrew is not fully cleared for four reasons: (1) the Hebrew running header is not in any supplied pack; (2) I can't confirm whether the Bible quotations on lines 14–15 and 19–20 carry cantillation; (3) the shin vowel in יִתְחַשֵּׁב/יִתְיַשֵּׁב and some small ticks are unresolved; (4) several dagesh and sheva-versus-vowel points remain faint.
